{{Quote|You're out of your mind, kid!|The trooper, to Ezra Bridger|<ref name="Visions and Voices" />}}
A '''rebel trooper''' of [[Phoenix Cell]] was at [[Chopper Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Atollon]] in [[2 BBY]], when he was attacked by [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]]. Ezra, under the influence of [[Dark side of the Force|Dark Side]] hallucinations brought on by the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], saw the trooper as Maul and attacked him. He was prevented from killing the trooper by the intervention of [[Sabine Wren]] and [[Kanan Jarrus]], who snapped Ezra out of the hallucination. The trooper told Ezra he was out of his mind before running away.<ref name="Visions and Voices" />

==Behind the scenes==
This trooper first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Visions and Voices]]," the eleventh episode of the show's [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]].<ref name="Visions and Voices" />
